title: Reel 1.0
description: A reel/1 document (reel.json): a story told as slides on a 16:9 canvas. Each slide has timed layers (image, video, text, shape) and audio clips; music can play under the whole reel. Units: x and w are percent of the canvas width, y and h percent of the canvas height; text size, padding, radius and strokeWidth are percent of the canvas height; times are seconds from the start of the slide; volume and opacity are 0–1. Unknown fields are errors. Rules this schema cannot express (unique slide ids, layer and audio times within the slide, video trimStart < duration, https URLs that parse, no percent-encoded dot segments in paths) are listed in the reel-schema README and checked by validateReel() in the reel-format package. Authoring guide: https://unpkg.com/reel-schema@1/GUIDE.md

$schema.description: Optional: the URL of this schema, so editors offer autocompletion and checks. Ignored by players – it is the only field that is not part of the format. Use https://unpkg.com/reel-schema@1/reel-1.schema.json.

format.description: Always "reel/1". reel/1 is frozen: fields are never added, removed or given a new meaning.

title.description: Title of the reel, 1–120 characters. Shown in lists and catalogues; the player does not draw it – put a title card on the first slide for that.

description.description: What the reel is about, at most 500 characters. Not shown by the player.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the text and narration, at most 35 characters.

tags.description: Keywords for catalogues and search: at most 20 tags of 1–40 characters.

music.description: Background music under the whole reel. It loops, and is lowered while audio clips with duck play.

defaults.description: Values used when a slide or layer does not set its own: a text style and a transition.

slides.description: The slides, played in order, 1–500. The reel lasts as long as its slides together.

color.title: Colour
color.description: A colour as #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa (hexadecimal, any case). The last pair is opacity: #00000099 is black at 60 %. Short forms (#fff), names (white) and rgb() are not allowed – write #ffffff.
color.$comment: The "not" rejects a newline for regex engines (Python, .NET, PCRE) in which $ also matches before a final newline.

imageSrc.title: Image src
imageSrc.description: An image file: media/… (a file in the package, relative to reel.json) or an https:// URL, at most 2000 characters. A relative path ends in .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .svg or .gif (any case); its segments are separated by / and none is empty, "." or ".."; it has no \, ?, # or control characters (spaces and other characters are fine, e.g. media/my photo.jpg). An https:// URL must be a valid absolute URL with a host and no spaces or control characters; any path works (a CDN URL without an extension is fine), but the file should be of a listed type. http:// is not allowed.
imageSrc.$comment: The "not" rejects a newline for regex engines (Python, .NET, PCRE) in which $ also matches before a final newline.

audioSrc.title: Audio src
audioSrc.description: An audio file: media/… (a file in the package, relative to reel.json) or an https:// URL, at most 2000 characters. A relative path ends in .mp3, .m4a, .aac or .wav (any case); its segments are separated by / and none is empty, "." or ".."; it has no \, ?, # or control characters (spaces and other characters are fine, e.g. media/my voice.mp3). An https:// URL must be a valid absolute URL with a host and no spaces or control characters; any path works (a CDN URL without an extension is fine), but the file should be of a listed type. http:// is not allowed.
audioSrc.$comment: The "not" rejects a newline for regex engines (Python, .NET, PCRE) in which $ also matches before a final newline.

videoSrc.title: Video src
videoSrc.description: A video file, MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio: media/… (a file in the package, relative to reel.json) or an https:// URL, at most 2000 characters. A relative path ends in .mp4 (any case); its segments are separated by / and none is empty, "." or ".."; it has no \, ?, # or control characters (spaces and other characters are fine, e.g. media/my clip.mp4). An https:// URL must be a valid absolute URL with a host and no spaces or control characters; any path works (a CDN URL without an extension is fine), but the file should be of a listed type. http:// is not allowed.
videoSrc.$comment: The "not" rejects a newline for regex engines (Python, .NET, PCRE) in which $ also matches before a final newline.

music.title: Music
music.description: Background music under the whole reel. It loops when it ends and plays across slides.

src.description: The music file: mp3, m4a, aac or wav.

duration.description: Real length of the music file in seconds, 0.1–86 400. The player needs it to start at the right place when the reel is started or sought mid-way. Get it with: ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 music.mp3

volume.description: Volume, 0–1. Default 0.25. Under narration, 0.15–0.3 works well.

duckTo.description: Volume while an audio clip with duck plays, 0–1. Default 0.08. The music glides down and back up.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Values used when a slide or layer does not set its own.

style.description: Merged into every text layer's style: player default → defaults.text.style → the layer's style. Set the reel's font, size and caption background here once.

transition.description: Used by every slide without a transition of its own. Without it, slides fade in over 1 s.

transition.title: Transition
transition.description: How a slide appears: { "type": "fade", "duration": 1 } or { "type": "cut" }. The transition is part of the slide's own time: a 1 s fade uses the first second of the slide.

fadeTransition.title: Fade
fadeTransition.description: The slide fades in over the previous one.

duration.description: Seconds, 0–5. Default 1. 0.5–1.5 s feels calm; 0 is the same as a cut.

cutTransition.title: Cut
cutTransition.description: The slide appears at once. A cut has no other fields.

textStyle.title: Text style
textStyle.description: How text looks. Merged field by field: player default → defaults.text.style → the layer's style.

font.description: The device's own sans-serif or serif font; nothing is downloaded. Default sans.

size.description: Font size, percent of the canvas height, 1.5–20 (5 ≈ 54 px on a 1080p screen). Default 5. Use ≥ 4.5 for body text read on a TV, 6–9 for titles, 3–3.5 only for short labels.

background.description: Colour behind the text itself plus padding, e.g. #00000099. Default: none. Gives contrast on busy pictures; for a band across the full width use a shape layer under the text.

padding.description: Space between the text and its background, percent of the canvas height, 0–10. Default 0. 1–1.5 looks good with a background.

radius.description: Rounded corners of the background, percent of the canvas height, 0–50. Default 0.

lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size, 0.8–3. Default 1.25.

shadow.description: Soft dark shadow behind the letters, for legibility on pictures. Default true when the style has no background, else false.

slide.title: Slide
slide.description: One page of the reel: layers drawn on the canvas for a number of seconds, and the audio clips played meanwhile.

id.description: Name of the slide, 1–80 characters, unique in the reel. Used to jump to the slide and reported when it has been shown.

duration.description: How long the slide is shown, in seconds, 1–600, including its transition. With narration: start of the clip + its length + about 1.5 s.

transition.description: How this slide appears. Default: defaults.transition, else a 1 s fade.

layers.description: 1–12 layers, drawn in order: the first is at the back, later layers are on top.

audio.description: 0–4 audio clips played during the slide: narration, sound effects, voices. Each must end within the slide.

credit.description: Credit for the slide's pictures or sounds, at most 200 characters, drawn small (1.8 % of the canvas height) in the lower right corner. Keep other text out of that corner.

audioClip.title: Audio clip
audioClip.description: A sound played during a slide: narration, a sound effect, a voice.

src.description: The audio file: mp3, m4a, aac or wav.

start.description: When the clip starts, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default 0. 0.5–1 s lets the slide appear first.

duration.description: Real length of the audio file in seconds, 0.1–600 (not how long you want it to play). start + duration must be at most the slide's duration (0.05 s tolerance).

duck.description: Lower the music to music.duckTo while this clip plays. Default true. Use false for short sound effects.

transcript.description: What is said, at most 2000 characters. Not shown; kept for accessibility and search. Show it on screen with a text layer if wanted.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: Something drawn on the slide, chosen by "type": image, video, text or shape.

imageLayer.title: Image layer
imageLayer.description: A picture: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, svg or gif.

x.description: Left edge of the layer, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 0. Keep text and important details inside 5–95 %.

y.description: Top edge of the layer, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 0.

w.description: Width, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 100 (the full width).

h.description: Height, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 100 (the full height). A box with w : h = 9 : 16 is square on the 16:9 canvas.

start.description: When the layer appears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default 0. Must be less than the slide's duration.

end.description: When the layer disappears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default: the end of the slide. Must be after start and at most the slide's duration (0.05 s tolerance).

fadeIn.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade in after start, 0–600. Default 0 (appears at once). 0.5–1 s is soft. fadeIn and fadeOut are shortened proportionally if together they are longer than the layer is visible.

fadeOut.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade out before end, 0–600. Default 0. Usually not needed on layers that last to the end of the slide: the next slide's fade covers them.

opacity.description: Opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Default 1. 0.3–0.5 dims a background picture under a title.

fit.description: How the picture fills the layer's box: cover fills it and crops what does not fit, contain shows the whole picture with empty space around it. Default cover.

alt.description: What the picture shows, at most 300 characters. Not drawn; read by screen readers and used for search.
examples: A red fox sitting in the snow

motion.description: A slow zoom and pan while the layer is visible.

videoLayer.title: Video layer
videoLayer.description: A video clip (MP4 with H.264 and AAC). It starts playing when the layer appears.

x.description: Left edge of the layer, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 0. Keep text and important details inside 5–95 %.

y.description: Top edge of the layer, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 0.

w.description: Width, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 100 (the full width).

h.description: Height, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 100 (the full height). A box with w : h = 9 : 16 is square on the 16:9 canvas.

start.description: When the layer appears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default 0. Must be less than the slide's duration.

end.description: When the layer disappears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default: the end of the slide. Must be after start and at most the slide's duration (0.05 s tolerance).

fadeIn.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade in after start, 0–600. Default 0 (appears at once). 0.5–1 s is soft. fadeIn and fadeOut are shortened proportionally if together they are longer than the layer is visible.

fadeOut.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade out before end, 0–600. Default 0. Usually not needed on layers that last to the end of the slide: the next slide's fade covers them.

opacity.description: Opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Default 1. 0.3–0.5 dims a background picture under a title.

duration.description: Real length of the video file in seconds, 0.1–86 400.

fit.description: How the picture fills the layer's box: cover fills it and crops what does not fit, contain shows the whole picture with empty space around it. Default cover.

trimStart.description: Seconds into the clip to start from, 0–86 400, less than duration. Default 0.

muted.description: Play without sound. Default true when the slide has audio clips, else false.

volume.description: Volume of the clip's own sound, 0–1. Default 1.

loop.description: Start again from trimStart when the clip ends. Default false: the last frame stays on screen.

textLayer.title: Text layer
textLayer.description: Plain text in a box. Without h the box grows with the text.

x.description: Left edge of the layer, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 0. Keep text and important details inside 5–95 %.

y.description: Top edge of the layer, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 0.

w.description: Width, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 100 (the full width).

h.description: Height, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default: none – the text box grows downward from y with its content (leave room for every line). With h, valign places the text inside the box.

start.description: When the layer appears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default 0. Must be less than the slide's duration.

end.description: When the layer disappears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default: the end of the slide. Must be after start and at most the slide's duration (0.05 s tolerance).

fadeIn.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade in after start, 0–600. Default 0 (appears at once). 0.5–1 s is soft. fadeIn and fadeOut are shortened proportionally if together they are longer than the layer is visible.

fadeOut.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade out before end, 0–600. Default 0. Usually not needed on layers that last to the end of the slide: the next slide's fade covers them.

opacity.description: Opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Default 1. 0.3–0.5 dims a background picture under a title.

text.description: Plain text, 1–500 characters; \n is a line break. Never interpreted as HTML or Markdown. Keep a caption to 2–3 lines.
examples: Once upon a time, a little fox lived at the edge of the forest.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of the text in its box. Default left.

valign.description: Vertical alignment of the text in its box. Default top. Only has an effect when the layer has h.

style.description: This layer's text style, merged over defaults.text.style.

shapeLayer.title: Shape layer
shapeLayer.description: A rectangle or ellipse filling the layer's box: a caption band, a coloured card, a ring that points something out.

x.description: Left edge of the layer, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 0. Keep text and important details inside 5–95 %.

y.description: Top edge of the layer, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 0.

w.description: Width, percent of the canvas width, 0–100. Default 100 (the full width).

h.description: Height, percent of the canvas height, 0–100. Default 100 (the full height). A box with w : h = 9 : 16 is square on the 16:9 canvas.

start.description: When the layer appears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default 0. Must be less than the slide's duration.

end.description: When the layer disappears, seconds from the start of the slide, 0–600. Default: the end of the slide. Must be after start and at most the slide's duration (0.05 s tolerance).

fadeIn.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade in after start, 0–600. Default 0 (appears at once). 0.5–1 s is soft. fadeIn and fadeOut are shortened proportionally if together they are longer than the layer is visible.

fadeOut.description: Seconds the layer takes to fade out before end, 0–600. Default 0. Usually not needed on layers that last to the end of the slide: the next slide's fade covers them.

opacity.description: Opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Default 1. 0.3–0.5 dims a background picture under a title.

shape.description: rect or ellipse. A shape with w : h = 9 : 16 is a square or circle on the 16:9 canvas.

stroke.description: Outline colour. Default: none. Drawn only when strokeWidth is more than 0.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width, percent of the canvas height, 0–5. Default 0. 0.4–0.8 gives a clear line.

radius.description: Rounded corners of a rect, percent of the canvas height, 0–50. Default 0. Not used by ellipse.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: A slow zoom and pan through the time the layer is visible, from "from" to "to". Both are required; { "scale": 1 } is the picture as it is.

from.description: Zoom and focus point when the layer appears.

to.description: Zoom and focus point when the layer disappears.

motionPoint.title: Motion point
motionPoint.description: A zoom level and the point zoomed towards.

scale.description: Zoom, 1–2: 1 is the picture as fitted, 2 is twice as large. Default 1. 1 → 1.1–1.2 over a slide is a calm zoom.

x.description: The point zoomed towards, percent of the picture's width as shown in the layer's box (with cover, the visible part), 0–100. Default 50, the centre.

y.description: The point zoomed towards, percent of the picture's height as shown in the layer's box (with cover, the visible part), 0–100. Default 50, the centre.
